summary:
雷神技術EPS大超預期17%，營收年增8.7%顯示國防與商用航太雙引擎強勁。
• EPS 1.78美元，大幅超越預期1.52美元，超預期幅度16.95%
• 營收220.8億美元，年增8.72%，國防與商用航太雙引擎貢獻
• 獲利超預期幅度遠大於營收，顯示營運效率與利潤率改善
• 龐大訂單積壓（backlog）提供營收能見度
ai_view:
訊號強勁：EPS大超預期17%搭配8.7%營收年增，顯示國防（地緣政治需求）與商用航太（旅運復甦＋售後）雙引擎齊揚，獲利品質提升。短期股價有強支撑，35倍本益比反映高預期。中期關注引擎交付、售後服務利潤率與訂單積壓轉換。追蹤指標：各部門營收與利潤率、訂單積壓、自由現金流、國防訂單能見度與全年指引。

需留意：本益比34.96倍偏高，估值反映國防題材樂觀；供應鏈與零件交付瓶頸可能限制產量爬升；國防預算政治週期與商用航太循環風險

summary_en:
RTX beat EPS by 17% with 8.7% revenue growth, as defense and commercial-aerospace engines run strong.
• EPS of $1.78 sharply beat the $1.52 estimate by 16.95%
• Revenue of $22.08B grew 8.72%, with defense and commercial aerospace both contributing
• The earnings beat far exceeded revenue, indicating efficiency and margin gains
• A large backlog provides revenue visibility

ai_view_en:
Signal is strong: a 17% EPS beat with 8.7% revenue growth shows defense (geopolitical demand) and commercial aerospace (travel recovery plus aftermarket) running together, with improved earnings quality. Near-term the stock has solid support, with a 35x P/E reflecting high expectations. Mid-term watch engine deliveries, aftermarket margins and backlog conversion. Track: segment revenue and margins, backlog, free cash flow, defense order visibility and full-year guidance.

Watch：A 34.96x P/E is elevated, reflecting defense-theme optimism; Supply-chain and parts-delivery bottlenecks could cap output ramp; Defense-budget political cycles and commercial-aerospace cycle risk
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期16.95%，營收年增8.72%反映國防與航太需求穩。
